synthesizedFacts.fact: Retinoids can cause skin purging, which is an initial flare-up of acne due to increased skin cell turnover.
Skin purging from retinoids typically lasts between two to eight weeks.
Retinol must be converted into retinoic acid to be active, which may affect the intensity of purging.
Symptoms of retinol purging include flaking, peeling, redness, irritation, and changes in skin texture.
